title: Outrigger beam installation.
officialText:
Outrigger beams shall be installed with all bearing supports perpendicular to the beam
centerline and shall set and maintain the web in a vertical position. The shackle or clevis with which the rope is attached to the
outrigger beam shall be placed directly over the centerline of the stirrup.
